question:
AB is the common tangent to both circles as shown in the given figure. What is the distance between the centres of the circles?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d32d5438ced5fc8121d748e2f7d47b64255d256e29879b058515d578e89d401.png]
solution:
**Concept Used:**

The tangent from a circle is perpendicular to the radius of the circle.

Similarity of triangles

When two triangles are similar then their sides are in proportion

**Calculation:**

⇒ In the given diagram AB is tangent to both the circles

⇒ In circle with center C, angle{CAE} = 90°

⇒ In circle with center D, angle{DBA} = 90°

⇒ angle{AEC} = angle{BED} (vertically opposite angles)

⇒ So, triangleCAE is similar to triangleDBE
